💪 Build: Lanky Build
Tall and thin with long limbs and a narrow torso. Arms and legs seem slightly oversized for the frame. An angular, stretched-out presence.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.

Female: shoulders narrow and level with the hips, long thin neck, small jaw, a slight chest line on a long narrow torso. Male: shoulders bony and wide-set, long neck, angular jaw, a flat chest on a long narrow torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure stretched long.
